instructions: Revalidate exact local/remote/production baselines and writer inventory after start; freeze native probes and shared DTO/security/migration contracts before dependent dispatch. After explicit start, pause the same existing daily automation via supported tool, drain actual old/queued development writers, preserve old business availability. A new lock alone cannot fence the old prompt.
dispatchGate: User start message plus S0 current-baseline and private-input revalidation; Leader records exact dispatch commit and frozen interface SHA before activation. Preparation baseline is not automatically the later execution baseline.
repairCondition: Preserve root cause history. After two same-root-cause repair attempts, perform renewed diagnosis and record the decision before further repair. Installation and fixture errors are not product Red.
deliverable: Exact commit, changed paths, commands/exit codes, real Red/Green when applicable, raw evidence hashes outside Git, known gaps and integration notes. No invented production/model/browser passes.
